name: Lodestar
source:
On Halloween in Iceland, the sun sets early and most fishing boats are already back in port.
Noah, who took over the lighthouse from his late father, is keeping watch as a storm nears. One boat, the Lodestar, is still missing – and the townspeople are uneasy.

[From [url=https://loetch.itch.io/lodestar]Itch.io[/url]]
